Prevention: Plough soil 2-3 times before planting to destroy weeds, which act as host plants to aphids.
Grow maize or eggplant around the border as a barrier or trap crop.
Destroy crop residues or infested crop – make into compost.
Use grey/silver plastic mulch to repel aphids.
Monitoring: Scout regularly – everyday look for aphids on young shoots.
Direct Control: Use botanical pesticide (e.g. fresh neem, lemongrass, ginger) 1 litre/15 litres of water.
For early stage (low infestation) destroy aphids on infested crop by hand.
Spray water + Soap powder –or potassium salts (5 grams/litre).
